## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 362 captures during February 2026. This activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The capture total is presented for the reporting period and should be read alongside the number of images that could not be graded and the number of referable results identified.

## Image quality

Of the 362 captures, 29 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.0. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The result indicates the proportion of the reported capture activity affected by image-quality limitations during February 2026.

## Grading

Grading identified 84 referable results from the images available for assessment. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This provides the central measure of turnaround for the reporting period. Together, the grading volume and median lag describe the service’s assessment activity at Harbour Eye Clinic during February 2026.
